network.rationale: October design (docs/adsb_nn/design_report_1.json): 20 design fits. Piecewise-linear embeddings beat scalar rank inputs (rank -0.07% committee blend); target clipping at 5400 s, lr 5e-4, 1024x4 with dropout 0.2, dropout 0.2 + weight decay 1e-3 and a 10-epoch budget all blend worse; clipping at 21600 s, weight EMA, clip+EMA, 16-dim numeric and 32-dim categorical embeddings are within the base seed noise (single base seeds -0.73..-1.00%). Seed averaging dominates: the mean of 2/4/8 base seeds blends at -1.12/-1.25/-1.44% (committee level, best weight 0.35/0.40/0.45) and -0.50/-0.57/-0.66% on the October recipe proxy (best weight 0.40/0.45/0.50, flat between 0.45 and 0.55). TabM-mini k=4 is the best single network (167.49) but blends at -0.89% with error correlation 0.925 at ~3.2x the compute of a base seed, below two base seeds (-1.12%) - so the declared network is the base recipe with 16 fresh seeds (101-116), and the declared shares are 0.3/0.4/0.5/0.6 around the recipe optimum. The second tabm4 design seed was still running at declaration time and is reported as an addendum; it cannot change this choice.

prior_evidence.closed: residual-stage tuning (v25 shipped, v26/v27 null), committee seeds and re-weighting (v18/v20), calibration, test-time adaptation, matcher fixes, the LIRF unmatched weight (v28); none is re-tested here.

configuration.purpose: Re-read the v24 recipe's blend numbers now that the committee table carries the network. On non-LIRF rows v24 is 0.3 x (v9 + residual) + 0.7 x [(1 - a) x committee + a x network] with a = 0.5; the residual is zero on unmatched rows, so 0.3 of every unmatched non-LIRF prediction (60% of the non-LIRF error) is still v9. The 0.7 was chosen with a tree-only committee table (v18); the network moved that table by -1.46% on December, and adsb_nn's December reading preferred a larger network share (nn60 -1.587% vs nn50 -1.462%). Fits nothing.
configuration.selection: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero. Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v24. The rule of adsb_v25/v26/v27/nn, unchanged.
configuration.ship: If a candidate is selected: no refit is needed (every table is v24's). The shipped v24 ranking values are rebuilt from their recorded components (v9, residual, committee, network and LIRF twelve-month tables); the control numbers must reproduce the uploaded v24 exactly; then the selected numbers are applied, exported as the next version through the frozen submission contract, verified independently, audited (tools/audit_export.py), and uploaded only with the user's approval. LIRF rows must equal the uploaded v24.
